Jason et Lucia, selon Rockstar: Jason and Lucia, according to Rockstar
Jason Duval et Lucia Caminos savent depu: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos have always known the deck is stacked against them.
Quand un coup censé être facile tourne m: When a job that was supposed to be easy goes wrong, they end up on the dark side of the sunniest place in America, at the heart of a criminal conspiracy that stretches across the whole state of Leonida.
Pour s’en sortir, ils vont devoir compte: To make it out, they’ll have to rely on each other more than ever.
Jason a grandi parmi les escrocs, est pa: Jason grew up around grifters, did a stint in the Army and works in the Keys for local drug runners; Lucia is getting out of the Leonida Penitentiary, where fighting for her family landed her.
Rob Nelson, de Rockstar North, résume la: Rob Nelson, from Rockstar North, sums up what comes next for Famitsu: after the botched job, several people are hunting them, they hide out in Vice City and look for enough money to get out of it.
Rockstar assume le modèle de Bonnie et C: Rockstar openly takes Bonnie and Clyde as its model: Rupert Humphries, in charge of narrative, says so to Dazed.
